text: To triple a quantity means the new total is three times the original quantity. The increase alone is twice the original quantity. Distinguish the new total from the amount added.

A route through several ordered locations consists of the gaps between consecutive locations. List each consecutive pair once before adding distances. Three stores have two gaps between stores; a house and workplace add separate endpoint segments.

A round trip contains an outward journey and a return journey. Count every journey across the full day before multiplying by days per week and number of weeks. Morning and afternoon round trips must both be included.

For equal groups, total items equal number of groups multiplied by items per group. To find the number of groups, divide total items by items per group. Track units such as slices, slices per pie and pies. State assumptions when converting customers into slices.
